description: Source code implementing cryptographic and entropy functions for the Stanford SRP Authentication Project, including environment and filesystem hashing, high-entropy seed generation, and a SHA-1 based random number generator.

methods.name: t_envhash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-1 hash of all environment variables concatenated together.

methods.name: t_fshash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-1 hash based on directory tree and filesystem state for entropy.

methods.name: t_initrand
methods.description: Initializes the high-entropy seed for the random number generator using system and environment data.

methods.name: t_random
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes using SHA-1 feedback loop.

methods.name: t_sessionkey
methods.description: Creates an interleaved SHA-1 hash of a session key.
